name: Kujo Toshiaki
source:
A beautician whose manners make him seem like a gentle prince.
Behaves like a gentleman and has a sincere attitude, especially towards Konno.
He is often thought to be a feminine man because of his appearance, but his behavior is very masculine.
Has a very serious and straightforward personality.
